Water conservation

The association asks every plot holder to help with water conservation over the summer. The mains supply to the site is shared with the houses on the lane, and in a dry year the pressure drops in the evening when everyone opens their taps at once. Fill your butts from the roofs of the huts, water early in the morning, and leave the hoses coiled at the standpipes when you are done.

Marsh Lane Allotments, 4 Marsh Lane. Open from dawn to dusk.
